title: Conformal solving-degree / resource surrogate
original_requirement: Fit solving-degree surface over n,ell,m,presentation,order using all prior toy cells and conformal bounds to choose expensive measurements.
acceptance_criteria: Deduplicate complete source receipts; retain timeout/OOM as censored outcomes.
Predict degree,memory,completion cost separately; compare simple deterministic baselines.
Freeze holdout/prospective cells and report coverage only under justified sampling/exchangeability.
remaining_gaps: Existing heterogeneous result schemas need receipt-aware extraction and degree-definition reconciliation.
No trained surrogate/conformal calibration or prospective sampling/coverage protocol bound; do not use extrapolation coverage as a theorem.
execution_note: Commands are source bindings, not launch receipts; preserve original trials and output to a fresh location through the applicable runner. No official approval or status transition is implied.
original_audit_text: A surrogate for the solving-degree surface over n, ℓ, m, presentation and order, fitted with conformal bounds on the hundreds of toy cells already measured, to decide which expensive runs to buy.
